ဆရာကန်တော့ပွဲ
အတူတကွ သွားကြမည်။
လူစု မကွဲစေရ။
နွေဦးရာသီ
ပလွေသံ သာယာ၏။
အဝေးသို့ မသွားရ။
မယ်ငွေ၏ သားကလေး
အသား ဖြူဖွေးသည်။
ကလေး ထွားသည်။
ဤရွာကလေး သာယာသည်။
ရာသီမရွေး မအားကြပါ။
Teacher's offering ceremony
We will go together.
Do not let the group scatter.
Do not discriminate.
Be friendly.
Spring season
The sound of the flute is pleasant.
The cows are being led.
Do not go far away.
Choose a place and rest.
Ma Ngwe’s small child
The skin is white and fair.
He is also sturdy.
She holds him tenderly.
Keep him warm.
This small village is peaceful.
There are plenty of gourds and cucumbers.
They are busy in all seasons.
They keep cows.
They live happily.
ဆရာကန်တော့ပွဲကို ဘယ်လို သွားကြမလဲကွယ်။  --- အတူတကွ သွားကြမည်။
အတူတူသွားတဲ့အခါ ဘာမကွဲစေရဘူးလဲ။  --- လူစု မကွဲစေရ။
သူငယ်ချင်းအချင်းချင်း ဘယ်လို နေကြရမလဲ။  --- ဖော်ဖော်ရွေရွေ နေကြပါ။
ဘယ်ရာသီမှာ ပလွေသံ သာယာတာလဲ။  --- နွေဦးရာသီ
နွေဦးရာသီမှာ ဘာသံလေးက သာယာနေတာလဲ။  --- ပလွေသံ
မယ်ငွေရဲ့ သားကလေးက အသားအရေ ဘယ်လိုရှိသလဲ။  --- အသား ဖြူဖွေးသည်။
ဤရွာကလေး ဘာဖြစ်သလဲ။  --- သာယာ၏
ဘယ်အချိန်မှာ မအားကြတာလဲ။  --- ရာသီမရွေး
How will we go to the teacher paying-homage ceremony? --- We will go together.
What should not break up when going together? --- The group must not break up.
How should friends live with one another? --- Be friendly and hospitable.
In which season is the sound of the flute pleasant? --- Spring season.
What sweet sound is pleasant in the spring? --- The sound of the flute.
Which animals are being led along? --- Cows.
Where must you not go when herding cattle? --- Do not go far away.
Who has a little son? --- Mae Ngwe.
How is Mae Ngwe's son's complexion? --- Very fair-skinned.
How is the baby being cradled? --- Cradled tenderly.
What about this little village? --- It is peaceful and pleasant.
Which fruits are abundant? --- Gourds and cucumbers.
When are they busy? --- All seasons.
Which animals are raised in the village? --- Cows.
